visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair and a white "Mardi" t-shirt addresses the camera directly in a brightly lit indoor space with intricate gray floral wallpaper. She holds a silver, textured tube and gestures with her hands, displaying a friendly and energetic facial expression while looking into the lens. (2) The camera shifts to a close-up of the woman's forearm while another hand, presumably male, applies two streaks of pinkish lip product. The lighting remains bright, highlighting the texture and subtle color difference of the swatches as she observes them closely from her seated position. (3) The woman uses a heart-shaped pink mirror to apply the lipsticks to different sides of her lips. The editing uses fast cuts to show her checking the result, her facial expressions reflecting concentration and then pleasant surprise at the color payoff in the mirror. (4) Holding both the luxury and budget lipsticks, the woman points to her lips and gestures towards the camera, comparing the two sides. She smiles broadly, looking directly into the lens, with yellow and white text overlays emphasizing her points about their similarity. (5) An extreme close-up of her lips shows the glossy, pink finish. She talks animatedly, moving her head and hands to highlight the shine and color of the products, while the floral background provides a consistent, decorative context for the beauty review. (6) The video concludes with the woman making a playful "lightning" gesture with her fingers near her head. She continues to hold the lipsticks, looking happy and engaging the audience with a final smile before the screen displays a final call to action.
